findings.message: Composition root must inject TelemetryService into PanelService; declare in specs/memory/architecture.html before first PR to prevent DIP regression.
Handler regex-dispatch needs /api/agents and /api/workflows; _NOT_FOUND_BODY must stay synchronized with _RAW_ROUTES.
Privacy invariant must be enforced at aggregator dataclass level, not only at handler — no content/text/prompt/response/thinking fields in telemetry dataclasses.
Place SQLite + lock under ~/.dadaia/state/telemetry/ subdir to avoid ownership ambiguity with CLI state files.
SQLite local with WAL retained over file-per-day JSON aggregate; rationale in trade-off table.
Lazy-on-request ingestion selected over cron/inotify/daemon — zero background process, stdlib only.

decisions_required: D10 confirm: pricing table as in-repo Python module (auditable, requires PR) vs ~/.dadaia/config/pricing.json (operator-editable). Architect picked Python; operator may override in Phase 3 grill-me.
Composition root location must be declared in specs/memory/architecture.html before software-engineer starts implementation.
Migration of the 14 architecture decisions from this discovery HTML into specs/memory/architecture.html (SPEC-DOC-008 memory atomicity).
